description: Trigger: import/ihave_push.rs extract_message_id() calls line.to_ascii_lowercase() on every header line of every article to check for 'message-id:'. Bad behavior: each call heap-allocates a new String for every header line scanned. For a typical 20-header article processed 10,000 times (bulk import), this is 200,000 unnecessary String allocations. The fix is to use eq_ignore_ascii_case or starts_with a lowercase pattern in-place.
title: ihave_push extract_message_id allocates String per header line via to_ascii_lowercase
